status.q: Where do I see my order's status?
status.a: Enter the order number (e.g. PK-2569-00100) in the box above, or open My account › Orders. The tracking link in your e-mail works without signing in.

short.a: Delivered quantities may vary by ± 5%; any shortfall comes back as credit. For a bigger shortfall or damage, claim from the order page within {days} days of receipt.
short.aNoDays: Delivered quantities may vary by ± 5%; any shortfall comes back as credit. For a bigger shortfall or damage, claim from the order page.

lead.a: Each job's production time is shown with its price on the product page and the quotation, counted after the sample is approved and paid.

how.q: How do I get a quotation?
how.a: For instantly priced products, calculate the price and save it as a quotation — the price holds {days} days. For special sizes or materials, send a quotation request with the spec and we answer with a quotation.
how.aNoDays: For instantly priced products, calculate the price and save it as a quotation. For special sizes or materials, send a quotation request with the spec and we answer with a quotation.

volume.a: The price per piece falls with quantity; see the quantity table on each product page. For regular or multi-design orders, talk to sales.

files.a: PDF or AI on a getpack dieline; download the dieline on the upload page. Your file is checked before it goes into the cart.

proof.q: Do I see a sample before production?
proof.a: Yes. The team sends a sample for your approval on the order before every job starts.

invoice.q: How do I get a tax invoice?
invoice.a: Enter the tax-invoice details when you order; it is issued by {issuer} under the getpack brand.
invoice.aPlain: Enter the tax-invoice details when you order; it is issued under the getpack brand.

overdue.a: Orders are never cancelled automatically. Press “Re-check price and pay” on the order: the current price is checked and you pay from there.

cost.a: Shipping is priced from the destination postcode, shown when you price a product and in the cart.

track.q: Where do I track the parcel?
track.a: The order page and the tracking link show the delivery status, and the proof of delivery once it arrives.

open.q: How do I open a company account?
open.a: Enter the company details and attach the documents; the review takes 1–2 business days and you can order prepaid meanwhile.

credit.q: When can we apply for credit terms?
credit.a: After 3 orders, or with financial statements when you apply. Terms of 15–60 days; Finance decides the limit.

what.a: An ERP for packaging factories, free for every module with unlimited users, once the factory opens a factory account and signs the partner agreement with getpack.

privacy.a: No. Partner factories' names, locations and data are never shown to customers or anyone outside.

samples.q: Can I get material samples first?
samples.a: Order a material and print sample kit on the samples page.

help.a: The help centre covers ordering, files, payment and delivery.

measurement-basis.alt: A box whose outer and inner outlines take turns standing out
measurement-basis.label: outside ↔ inside
measurement-basis.caption: The inside size is the space for the goods; the outside is larger by the board's thickness.

bleed.alt: Artwork running past a cut line that shifts slightly
bleed.label: artwork 3 mm past the cut
bleed.caption: Even if the cut is slightly off, artwork past the edge means no white shows.

offset.alt: Cyan, magenta, yellow and black bars printing one after another
offset.label: cyan · magenta · yellow · black
offset.caption: Offset prints one colour at a time from plates, which pays off on large runs.
